meta.disclaimer: Compiled from secondary sources that reproduce Election Commission of India results (IndiaVotes, Wikipedia citing ECI). Vote counts were cross-checked between at least two sources; ECI result pages could not be fetched directly at compile time. Verify against ECI Form-21E / statistical reports before citing.

name: Pune
coverage: Urban core of Pune city: parts of the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) plus the Pune and Khadki Cantonment Boards and the Kalas revenue circle of Haveli tehsil. The constituency lies wholly within Pune district.
delimitationNote: Current boundaries come from the Delimitation Order, 2008 and were first used in the 2009 general election. Results before 2009 refer to different boundaries and are not compared here.

segments.name: Vadgaon Sheri
segments.extent: PMC wards 8–15, 64–68, 125–129; Kalas revenue circle of Haveli tehsil (excluding areas transferred to PMC)

segmentNotes: Ward numbers are the pre-2008 PMC ward numbers used in the Delimitation Order, not current ward numbers.
In the source PDF the ward lists for AC 214 and AC 215 are printed in side-by-side columns; the split between the two should be treated as approximate.
membersNote: List of MPs taken from Wikipedia and not independently cross-checked. 1951 was a two-member seat; only the general-seat member is shown.

demographics.title: Pune district
demographics.geography: District (larger than the constituency – includes rural tehsils and Pimpri-Chinchwad)
notes: Males + females and rural + urban both add up to the total population.
Literacy rate = literates ÷ population aged 7 and above (Census definition).
The official District Census Handbook could not be opened at compile time; figures come from secondary sites that agree with each other.

demographics.title: Pune Municipal Corporation
demographics.geography: City (PMC limits as of 2011) – closest available proxy for the constituency
notes: A municipal corporation is entirely urban by definition.
SC/ST figures for PMC could not be verified from a reliable source and are left unavailable.
The constituency does not match PMC exactly: it covers only part of PMC and also includes the Pune (71,781) and Khadki (78,684) Cantonment Boards and the Kalas circle.

demographics.title: Pune City tehsil
demographics.geography: Sub-district – similar but not identical area; used here only for SC/ST share

sources.label: City Population – Pune City tehsil, Census 2011

notes: Sex ratio computed from the male and female counts.

demographicsNote: The Census of India does not publish figures by parliamentary constituency. No official Pune PC-level demographic data exists, so district, city and tehsil figures are shown and labelled as such.
electoralSnapshotNote: Latest electors figure is from the 2024 Lok Sabha election.
